summary: Eaton Corporation plc filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement to separate its Mobility segment via a Reverse Morris Trust transaction with Dana Incorporated. Under the Separation Agreement, Eaton will transfer the Mobility business to a newly created SpinCo and distribute SpinCo shares to Eaton shareholders. Immediately following the distribution, SpinCo will merge with Dana. Terms such as price, premium, and exchange ratio were not disclosed in the excerpt. The board recommendation and advisors are not named. The transaction is structured as a tax-efficient Reverse Morris Trust, requiring regulatory approvals and shareholder votes. Watch for shareholder approval, regulatory clearance, and any termination fees.
